title: 月の光 — 屋根のオルゴール

source.title: Clair de lune (Suite bergamasque)
source.edition: E. Fromont, 1905; Keith OHara / Mutopia-1778 public-domain engraving and mechanically generated score MIDI, not a performance recording

arrangement: Opening 26 measures, lower register lightly raised into music-box range, own quiet D-flat cadence, gently varied timing and dynamics. Original synthesized music-box tines; no soundfont, recording or paid service.
loop: Circular note tails, reflections and warmed filter; no repeated short clips or abrupt end trim.
unchanged: Exact same 542 pitches/onsets/durations/velocities, 125.18s period, melody, tempo and cadence. Runtime gain/fades/player unchanged.
timbre: Own comb-tine synthesis. Same 1.2ms attack; clearer 2.7565 mode with natural longer modal ring; two-stage fundamental decay; damped high modes/4.2kHz two-pole lowpass; two quiet small-case reflections (total .048 vs v2 .073). Exact v2 score/events/period, no added notes or pitch/timing/velocity changes. Constant gain matches v2 RMS; runtime volume unchanged; no compression, samples or external recordings.
